subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: CTPI2, a third-generation SLC25A1 inhibitor, delays the onset of frailty in aged mice as measured by a validated 31-parameter frailty index, alongside improvements in fur condition, coordination, balance and grip strength. In aged tissues, CTPI2 suppresses SASP-associated inflammatory gene expression across skeletal muscle, liver and heart while leaving p16 and p21 unchanged, and circulating inflammatory cytokines are reduced, indicating a systemic attenuation of inflammatory burden. These benefits arise without broad metabolic reprogramming: body weight, composition, metabolic rate, respiratory exchange ratio, activity and lipid metabolic pathways are largely unaffected.
context.zh-TW: CTPI2 是第三代 SLC25A1 抑制劑，可延緩老年小鼠衰弱症的發生，此結果以經驗證的 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，同時伴隨毛皮狀況、協調性、平衡感與握力的改善。在老年組織中，CTPI2 可抑制骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中與 SASP 相關的發炎基因表現，同時不改變 p16 與 p21，且循環中的發炎細胞激素亦降低，顯示發炎負擔獲得全身性的減輕。這些效益的產生並未伴隨廣泛的代謝重編程：體重、身體組成、代謝率、呼吸交換比、活動量與脂質代謝途徑大多不受影響。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: Aged (19-month-old) C57BL/6 mice gavaged with CTPI2 (50 mg/kg three times weekly for 3 months) exhibited more lustrous fur, reduced alopecia and greying, and delayed onset of frailty as measured by a 31-parameter frailty index. Functional assessment revealed enhanced neuromuscular performance: improved coordination and balance (tightrope test), increased strength (hanging and grip strength tests) and preservation of muscle integrity. CTPI2 reduced SASP gene expression in skeletal muscle, liver and heart without altering p16 or p21, indicating that suppressing the mitochondrial citrate-acetyl-CoA axis improves healthspan through SASP modulation rather than senescent cell clearance.
context.zh-TW: 以 CTPI2（50 mg/kg，每週三次，持續 3 個月）管餵的老年（19 個月大）C57BL/6 小鼠，表現出更有光澤的毛皮、脫毛與毛髮灰白減少，且以 31 參數衰弱指數衡量，衰弱症的發生獲得延緩。功能評估顯示神經肌肉表現增強：協調性與平衡感改善（走鋼索測試）、肌力增加（懸掛與握力測試），並保留肌肉完整性。CTPI2 在不改變 p16 或 p21 的情況下，降低了骨骼肌、肝臟與心臟中的 SASP 基因表現，顯示抑制粒線體檸檬酸—乙醯輔酶 A 軸，是透過調節 SASP 而非清除衰老細胞來改善健康壽命。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

subject: CTPI2

context.en-US: CTPI2 is a third-generation inhibitor of the mitochondrial citrate carrier SLC25A1 with high binding affinity and specificity. CTPI2 treatment results in dose-dependent suppression of SASP components at transcript and protein levels without altering cell cycle regulators, HMGB1 localization, DNA damage foci or proliferation markers. It reduces global nuclear acetylation and H3K27ac at SASP loci and abolishes incorporation of glucose-derived carbon into histone acetylation, yet does not broadly impair mitochondrial function: OXPHOS gene expression, ATP production, coupling efficiency, mitochondrial ROS and morphology remain largely unchanged.
context.zh-TW: CTPI2 是粒線體檸檬酸載體 SLC25A1 的第三代抑制劑，具有高結合親和力與特異性。CTPI2 治療可在轉錄與蛋白質層面劑量依賴性地抑制 SASP 組成，同時不改變細胞週期調控因子、HMGB1 定位、DNA 損傷焦點或增殖標記。它可降低整體細胞核乙醯化及 SASP 基因座的 H3K27ac，並消除葡萄糖來源碳併入組蛋白乙醯化的現象，但不會廣泛損害粒線體功能：OXPHOS 基因表現、ATP 產生、偶聯效率、粒線體 ROS 與形態大多維持不變。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md

context.en-US: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
context.zh-TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

context.en-US: The oxidation state of the CxxC motif is a direct readout of cellular redox status: its cysteines switch client proteins between reduced (active) and oxidized (inactive or chaperone-like) states. Over-oxidation of the nucleophilic cysteine disables antioxidant enzymes and contributes to oxidative-stress-linked pathology.
context.zh-TW: CxxC 基序的氧化狀態是細胞氧化還原狀態的直接讀數：其半胱氨酸使客戶蛋白在還原（活化）與氧化（不活化或類伴侶）狀態之間切換。親核半胱氨酸的過度氧化會使抗氧化酵素失能，並促成與氧化壓力相關的病理。

context.en-US: After thioredoxins catalyze substrate reduction, their oxidized CxxC motif is regenerated by thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, while glutaredoxins are recycled by reduced glutathione. Electrons thus flow from NADPH or GSH through the CxxC motif to protein disulfide substrates.
context.zh-TW: 在硫氧還蛋白催化受質還原後，其被氧化的 CxxC 基序由硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，而 glutaredoxin 則由還原態麩胱甘肽回收。因此電子從 NADPH 或 GSH 經 CxxC 基序流向蛋白質雙硫受質。

context.en-US: Cytokines are small secreted signaling proteins that mediate communication between immune and resident cells. In the CNS, microglia and infiltrating lymphocytes release cytokines that coordinate neuroinflammation, a process implicated in Parkinson's disease progression.
context.zh-TW: 細胞激素是介導免疫細胞與駐留細胞溝通的小型分泌性訊號蛋白。在中樞神經系統中，微膠質細胞與浸潤淋巴球釋放細胞激素以協調神經發炎，此過程與帕金森氏症的進展有關。

context.en-US: In the parkinsonian brain, activated microglia release pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 that exacerbate oxidative stress and alpha-synuclein aggregation. Cytokine networks integrate the immune axis with oxidative, lysosomal, and proteostatic hypotheses of parkinsonism.
context.zh-TW: 在帕金森腦中，活化的微膠質細胞釋放 TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，加劇氧化壓力與 alpha-synuclein 聚集。細胞激素網路將免疫軸與帕金森症的氧化、溶酶體及蛋白質恆定假說整合。

context.en-US: DELE1, previously identified as a poorly characterized mitochondrial protein from a yeast two-hybrid screen, was converged upon by two independent CRISPR-based screens as the mediator of mitochondrial stress signaling to the ISR. Under mitochondrial stress, the cleaved cytosolic fragment DELE1-S directly binds and activates the heme-regulated kinase HRI. Importantly, HRI activation by DELE1 was shown to be heme-independent, ruling out the classical heme-depletion mechanism. HRI activation in turn leads to eIF2alpha phosphorylation and downstream ATF4 induction, linking mitochondrial dysfunction to the integrated stress response.
context.zh-TW: DELE1 先前在酵母雙雜交篩選中被鑑定為一個特性不明的粒線體蛋白，而兩個獨立的 CRISPR 篩選共同指向它作為粒線體壓力訊號傳遞至 ISR 的媒介。在粒線體壓力下，被切割的細胞質片段 DELE1-S 直接結合並活化血基質調控激酶 HRI。重要的是，DELE1 對 HRI 的活化被證實與血基質無關，排除了經典的血基質耗竭機制。HRI 活化接著導致 eIF2alpha 磷酸化與下游 ATF4 誘導，將粒線體功能障礙與整合性壓力反應連結起來。

context.en-US: Low-dose mTORC1 inhibition by rapamycin improves immune responses by increasing dendritic cell activity and CD8+ memory T-cell counts. This potentiation is dose-dependent and immunostimulatory at low dose while immunosuppressive at high dose.
context.zh-TW: 低劑量 rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 可透過增加樹突細胞活性與 CD8+ 記憶 T 細胞數量來改善免疫反應。此增強作用具劑量依賴性，低劑量免疫刺激、高劑量免疫抑制。

context.en-US: Depression has complex neurobiological underpinnings including monoamine dysregulation, inflammation, and oxidative stress. Elevated inflammatory cytokines impair neurotransmitter metabolism, linking neuroinflammation to the pathophysiology of major depressive disorder.
context.zh-TW: 憂鬱症的神經生物學基礎複雜，包括單胺失調、發炎與氧化壓力。升高的發炎細胞激素會損害神經傳導物質代謝，將神經發炎與重度憂鬱症的病理生理相連結。

subject: Diabetes Mellitus

context.en-US: Diabetes mellitus is often seen as a form of accelerated aging, and the levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of their equivalent normal non-diabetics. Advanced glycation end products are increased in diabetes and play an important role in the development of diabetic complications. Aminoguanidine acts to bind to sugars, preventing them from binding to the lysine groups of proteins, and diabetic clinical trials with humans have highlighted its ability to prevent oxidative modification of LDL, inhibit atherosclerotic plaque formation, reduce albuminuria and delay end-stage renal disease.
context.zh-TW: 糖尿病常被視為一種加速老化的形式，而糖尿病患者體內的交聯產物濃度是年齡相當的正常非糖尿病者的二至三倍。晚期糖化終產物在糖尿病中增加，並在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。胺基胍的作用是與糖結合，防止糖與蛋白質的離胺酸基團結合；人體糖尿病臨床試驗已突顯其預防 LDL 氧化修飾、抑制動脈粥狀硬化斑塊形成、減少白蛋白尿並延緩末期腎病的能力。

source_document: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md

context.en-US: Dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) is a pharmaceutical vehicle that enhances fenbendazole delivery by improving solubility and inhibiting CYP2C19/CYP3A4 metabolism. DMSO-mediated inhibition prolongs fenbendazole systemic exposure, enhancing its cytotoxicity even in paclitaxel-resistant cells.
context.zh-TW: 二甲基亞碸（DMSO）是藥品載體，透過改善溶解度並抑制 CYP2C19/CYP3A4 代謝來增進 fenbendazole 遞送。DMSO 介導的抑制延長 fenbendazole 的全身暴露，即使在 paclitaxel 抗藥細胞中也能增強其細胞毒性。

context.en-US: DNA encodes the genetic framework that determines pigment-cell fate and the enzymes of catecholamine synthesis and neuromelanin production. Genetic variants influence how dopaminergic neurons synthesize and handle pigment, linking DNA to neuromelanin and Parkinson's susceptibility.
context.zh-TW: DNA 編碼決定色素細胞命運及兒茶酚胺合成與 neuromelanin 生成酶的遺傳框架。基因變異影響多巴胺神經元如何合成與處理色素，將 DNA 與 neuromelanin 及帕金森氏症易感性相連結。

context.en-US: Parkinson's disease risk is shaped by DNA variants in SNCA, LRRK2, PARKIN, PINK1, and GBA1. Accumulated DNA damage in aging dopaminergic neurons, coupled with diminished repair, contributes to the selective death of pigmented neurons in PD.
context.zh-TW: 帕金森氏症風險受 SNCA、LRRK2、PARKIN、PINK1 與 GBA1 的 DNA 變異影響。衰老多巴胺神經元中累積的 DNA 損傷加上修復能力下降，促成 PD 中色素神經元的選擇性死亡。

context.en-US: Some bis-benzimidazole compounds bind the minor groove of DNA at specific sequences and inhibit DNA helicase activity, thereby blocking cell proliferation. This mechanism is relevant to fenbendazole-family benzimidazoles as potential anticancer agents.
context.zh-TW: 某些雙苯並咪唑化合物結合 DNA 小溝的特定序列並抑制 DNA 解旋酶活性，從而阻斷細胞增殖。此機制與 fenbendazole 家族苯並咪唑作為潛在抗癌藥有關。

context.en-US: DNA-SCARS may serve as precursors to cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCF) that trigger inflammation via cGAS-STING. CCF derived from DNA-SCARS are enriched in heterochromatin marks and activate the cGAS-STING-NF-kB axis.
context.zh-TW: DNA-SCARS 可能作為細胞質染色質片段（CCF）的前驅物，經由 cGAS-STING 觸發發炎。源自 DNA-SCARS 的 CCF 富含異染色質標記，並活化 cGAS-STING-NF-κB 軸。

context.en-US: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
context.zh-TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

context.en-US: dNTPs are consumed stoichiometrically by DNA polymerases during DNA replication and repair, and their supply is rate-limiting. Balanced dNTP pools are essential for high-fidelity replication; both depletion and imbalance drive replication stress, mutagenesis, and genomic instability.
context.zh-TW: dNTP 在 DNA 複製與修復期間被 DNA 聚合酶以化學計量方式消耗，其供應具有速率限制。平衡的 dNTP 池對高保真複製至關重要；耗竭與失衡皆會驅動複製壓力、突變與基因體不穩定性。

context.en-US: dNTP depletion leads to replication fork stalling and collapse, activating ATR/ATM checkpoints and triggering DNA replication stress, senescence, or apoptosis. This dNTP-catastrophe axis is how agents such as hydroxyurea impose cell-cycle arrest.
context.zh-TW: dNTP 耗竭會導致複製叉停滯與崩潰，活化 ATR/ATM 檢查點並觸發 DNA 複製壓力、衰老或細胞凋亡。此 dNTP 災難軸正是 Hydroxyurea 等藥物造成細胞週期停滯的機制。

context.en-US: Hydroxyurea quenches the ribonucleotide reductase tyrosyl radical, starving cells of dNTPs. The resulting dNTP depletion causes replication fork stalling, DNA replication stress, and cell-cycle arrest or senescence.
context.zh-TW: Hydroxyurea 淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶的酪胺醯自由基，使細胞缺乏 dNTP。由此造成的 dNTP 耗竭會導致複製叉停滯、DNA 複製壓力以及細胞週期停滯或衰老。

context.en-US: dNTPs (dATP, dGTP, dCTP, dTTP) are the four deoxyribose building blocks of DNA, produced de novo by ribonucleotide reductase via reduction of NDPs to dNDPs followed by phosphorylation. RNR is the rate-limiting, allosterically committed step of this synthesis.
context.zh-TW: dNTP（dATP、dGTP、dCTP、dTTP）是 DNA 的四種去氧核糖建構單元，由核醣核苷酸還原酶將 NDP 還原為 dNDP 再經磷酸化而 de novo 合成。RNR 是此合成中速率限制、別構承諾的步驟。

context.en-US: Tyrosine hydroxylase (TH) is the rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine biosynthesis, converting tyrosine to L-DOPA. Loss of dopaminergic transmission from TH-positive neurons causes the motor syndrome of Parkinson's disease, and TH serves as a marker of vulnerable dopaminergic neurons.
context.zh-TW: 酪氨酸羥化酶（TH）是兒茶酚胺生合成的限速酶，將酪氨酸轉化為 L-DOPA。TH 陽性神經元的多巴胺能傳遞喪失造成帕金森氏症的運動症候群，TH 作為易受傷害多巴胺神經元的標記。

context.en-US: Double-strand breaks are the principal trigger for the recruitment of chromatin modifiers away from their native genomic loci to damage sites. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated cycles of DSB-induced relocalization are proposed to erode the epigenetic landscape over time.
context.zh-TW: 雙股斷裂是染色質修飾因子被招募離開原生基因座至損傷位點的主要觸發因素。在 RCM 假說中，反覆的 DSB 誘導易位被認為會隨時間侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

context.en-US: The double-stranded RNA-binding domain (dsRBD) binds double-stranded RNA in a structure-specific manner and positions RNA substrates for processing enzymes. DGCR8 and Dicer use tandem dsRBDs to recognize and process microRNA precursors.
context.zh-TW: 雙股 RNA 結合結構域（dsRBD）以結構特異方式結合雙股 RNA，並將 RNA 受質定位給加工酶。DGCR8 與 Dicer 利用串聯 dsRBD 來辨識與加工 microRNA 前驅物。

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: Biochemical evaluation of Alzheimer's disease (AD) brains demonstrates significantly increased DRP1 and FIS1 and reduced MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1 mRNA and protein levels, correlating with mitochondrial fragmentation and compromised neuronal energy production. Excessive mitochondrial fission interferes with OXPHOS complex assembly and cristae integrity, and S-nitrosylation of DRP1 induced by amyloid beta triggers mitochondrial fission and neuronal damage. Significantly increased DRP1 phosphorylation at Ser616 stimulates DRP1 translocation to mitochondria and fission activity in AD brain, and impaired axonal transport and reduced mitophagy accompany AD progression.
context.zh-TW: 對阿茲海默症（AD）腦部的生化評估顯示，DRP1與FIS1的mRNA及蛋白質表現量顯著增加，而MFN1、MFN2與OPA1則降低，此變化與粒線體碎裂及神經元能量產生受損相關。過度的粒線體分裂會干擾OXPHOS複合體組裝與嵴（cristae）完整性，而由類澱粉蛋白β（amyloid beta）誘發的DRP1 S-亞硝基化則會觸發粒線體分裂與神經元損傷。AD腦中DRP1在Ser616的磷酸化顯著增加，刺激DRP1轉位至粒線體並增強分裂活性，而軸突運輸受損與粒線體自噬（mitophagy）減少伴隨AD病程進展。

source_document: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

context.en-US: Drp1 is the GTP-binding protein that executes mitochondrial fission: it translocates from the cytosol to mitochondria to sever the organelle, a prerequisite for segregating damaged mitochondria and enacting mitophagy. Drp1-mediated fission sits at the hub of multiple death modalities — PGAM5 and RIPK3 recruit it for necroptosis, BNIP3-interacting pathways engage it in apoptosis, and Parkin regulates its activity and degradation by polyubiquitination. Its recruitment is therefore both a quality-control step and a death-priming step depending on context.
context.zh-TW: Drp1 是執行粒線體分裂的 GTP 結合蛋白：它會由細胞質轉位至粒線體將其切斷，這是隔離受損粒線體並執行粒線體自噬的前提。Drp1 介導的分裂位於多種死亡模式的樞紐——PGAM5 與 RIPK3 為程序性壞死而招募它，BNIP3 相關路徑在細胞凋亡中動用它，而 Parkin 則透過多泛素化調控其活性與降解。因此 Drp1 的招募依情境不同，既可能是品質管制步驟，也可能是死亡致敏步驟。

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: Cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane (OMM) to initiate fission, where they are anchored by four main adaptor proteins: mitochondrial fission factor (MFF), mitochondrial fission 1 protein (FIS1), and mitochondrial dynamics proteins MID49 and MID51. These adaptors physically interact within a DRP1 complex to coordinate fission, and MFF, MID49 and MID51 are directly associated with mitochondrial division; their absence leads to significant mitochondrial elongation. The endoplasmic reticulum and ER-mitochondria contact sites (MAMs) provide a platform for DRP1 oligomerization and constriction of the OMM.
context.zh-TW: 細胞質中的 DRP1 單體被招募至粒線體外膜（OMM）以啟動分裂，並由四個主要接合蛋白錨定：粒線體分裂因子（MFF）、粒線體分裂 1 蛋白（FIS1），以及粒線體動力學蛋白 MID49 與 MID51。這些接合蛋白在 DRP1 複合體中物理性交互作用以協調分裂，其中 MFF、MID49 與 MID51 直接與粒線體分裂相關；它們的缺失會導致粒線體顯著延長。內質網與內質網—粒線體接觸位點（MAMs）為 DRP1 寡聚化及 OMM 的收縮提供平台。

source_document: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md

subject: DRP1

context.en-US: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
context.zh-TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

source_document: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md

context.en-US: Because DunedinPACE captures the rate of aging, it is suited to testing whether interventions slow the aging process itself, linking directly to healthspan. It predicts later physical and cognitive functioning and incidence of multiple age-related diseases from a single blood sample.
context.zh-TW: 由於 DunedinPACE 捕捉老化速率，它適合測試介入措施是否減緩老化過程本身，直接與健康壽命（healthspan）相連結。它可從單一血液樣本預測後續身體與認知功能及多種年齡相關疾病的發生。

context.en-US: DunedinPACE is a rate-based epigenetic estimator of the pace of aging, complementary to the level-based PhenoAge clock. Where PhenoAge estimates biological-age level, DunedinPACE estimates rate, so the two together describe both position and trajectory of aging.
context.zh-TW: DunedinPACE 是基於速率的表觀遺傳老化速度估算器，與基於水平的 PhenoAge 時鐘互補。PhenoAge 估算生物年齡水平，DunedinPACE 則估算速率，兩者共同描述老化的位置與軌跡。

context.en-US: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
context.zh-TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

context.en-US: Endostatin is a 20 kDa collagen XVIII-derived fragment that acts as a potent endogenous inhibitor of angiogenesis, restraining tumor growth and metastasis. Its regulation and matrix-derived abundance change with tissue remodeling in aging.
context.zh-TW: Endostatin 是 20 kDa 的 XVIII 型膠原蛋白衍生片段，是抑制血管生成、約束腫瘤生長與轉移的強效內源性抑制劑。其調控與基質衍生豐度隨衰老的組織重塑而改變。

context.en-US: In cellular senescence, large-scale rewiring of the enhancer-promoter network is a primary mechanism by which the epigenetic landscape activates SASP genes. EP loops place senescence-activated enhancers in contact with SASP promoters to induce their secretion.
context.zh-TW: 在細胞衰老中，增強子-啟動子網路的大規模重組是表觀遺傳景觀活化 SASP 基因的主要機制。EP 環化使衰老活化的增強子與 SASP 啟動子接觸以誘導其分泌。

context.en-US: Enhancer-promoter looping is the physical folding that brings distal enhancers into proximity with target promoters. Senescence-activated super-enhancers are placed in contact with key SASP genes through EP looping, making 3D contact maps informative for predicting SASP.
context.zh-TW: 增強子-啟動子環化是使遠端增強子與目標啟動子靠近的物理摺疊。衰老活化的超級增強子（super-enhancer）透過 EP 環化與關鍵 SASP 基因接觸，使三維接觸圖譜對預測 SASP 具有資訊價值。

context.en-US: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
context.zh-TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

context.en-US: Enzalutamide is a nonsteroidal anti-androgen used in endocrine therapy of prostate cancer.
context.zh-TW: Enzalutamide 是一種非甾體抗雄激素，用於前列腺癌的內分泌治療。

context.en-US: Enzalutamide is approved for castration-resistant prostate cancer.
context.zh-TW: Enzalutamide 獲准用於去勢抵抗性前列腺癌。

context.en-US: Epacadostat is a small-molecule inhibitor of IDO1 tested in clinical trials as an immuno-oncology strategy, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors targeting PD-1/PD-L1. These combinations aim to relieve IDO1-mediated immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment by blocking tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, thereby restoring effector T cell function. However, results from such trials have been mixed, and challenges including isoform selectivity, compensatory pathways (TDO, IDO2), and context-specific effects have limited clinical success.
context.zh-TW: Epacadostat是一種IDO1的小分子抑制劑，已在臨床試驗中作為免疫腫瘤學策略進行測試，常與標靶PD-1/PD-L1的檢查點抑制劑合併使用。這些合併療法旨在透過阻斷色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）生成，來解除腫瘤微環境中IDO1介導的免疫抑制，從而恢復效應T細胞功能。然而，此類試驗的結果好壞參半，包括異構體選擇性、代償途徑（TDO、IDO2）與情境依賴性效應等挑戰，限制了臨床上的成功。

context.en-US: Epigenetic aging reflects the accumulation of age-related chromatin changes integrated into epigenetic clocks. Epigenetic derepression of retroelements and heterochromatin loss fuels inflammaging, linking epigenetic age acceleration to chronic inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 表觀遺傳老化反映累積的與年齡相關染色質變化，並整合入表觀遺傳時鐘。反轉錄轉座子的表觀去抑制與異染色質喪失助長發炎老化，將表觀遺傳年齡加速與慢性發炎相連結。

context.en-US: The epigenetic landscape denotes the ensemble of chromatin states that establish cellular identity. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated recruitment of chromatin modifiers to DNA repair sites causes gradual erosion of this landscape, leading to loss of cellular identity and aging phenotypes.
context.zh-TW: 表觀遺傳景觀指建立細胞身分的染色質狀態總和。在 RCM 假說中，染色質修飾因子被反覆招募至 DNA 修復位點會造成此景觀的逐漸侵蝕，導致細胞身分喪失與衰老表現型。

context.en-US: Erastin, the prototype class-I ferroptosis inducer, blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter system xc- (SLC7A11), depleting intracellular cysteine and thereby glutathione. Without GSH, GPX4 cannot reduce lipid peroxides, and iron-driven Fenton chemistry plus LOX-mediated oxidation accumulate lethal lipid peroxides. Erastin additionally induces ER stress that activates the CHOP-PUMA axis, recruiting apoptosis on top of ferroptosis — a combined-death approach relevant to cancer therapy.
context.zh-TW: Erastin 是第一類鐵死亡誘導劑的原型，會阻斷胱胺酸/麩胺酸反向轉運蛋白 system xc-（SLC7A11），耗竭細胞內胱胺酸進而耗盡麩胱甘肽。缺乏 GSH 時，GPX4 無法還原脂質過氧化物，鐵驅動的 Fenton 化學與 LOX 介導的氧化便累積致命的脂質過氧化物。Erastin 還會誘導內質網壓力、活化 CHOP-PUMA 軸線，在鐵死亡之上疊加細胞凋亡——這是與癌症治療相關的複合死亡策略。

context.en-US: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
context.zh-TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

context.en-US: Estrogen receptor drives luminal breast cancer and its expression guides endocrine therapy. Flavonoids such as apigenin show biphasic estrogenic/anti-estrogenic activity via ER-binding-dependent and -independent mechanisms, with apigenin exerting anti-estrogenic effects in breast cancer cells.
context.zh-TW: 雌激素受體驅動管腔型乳癌，其表現指引內分泌治療。諸如 apigenin 等黃酮類透過 ER 結合依賴與非依賴機制表現雙相雌激素/抗雌激素活性，apigenin 在乳癌細胞中發揮抗雌激素作用。

subject: Everolimus

context.en-US: Two randomized placebo-controlled clinical trials tested rapalogs among the elderly for immunomodulation. Treatment with everolimus monotherapy or everolimus in combination with RTB101 for six weeks resulted in a better response to influenza vaccine and fewer infections over the next year compared to placebo. The proposed mechanism is an increase in autophagy through inhibition of mTOR along with increased expression of antiviral proteins. The observation that immune function improves after a single six-week period of mTORC1 inhibition has important clinical implications, since elderly patients are particularly at risk of dying from influenza.
context.zh-TW: 兩項隨機、安慰劑對照的臨床試驗在老年族群中測試了rapalog的免疫調節作用。與安慰劑相比，單用everolimus或以everolimus合併RTB101治療六週，可獲得較佳的流感疫苗反應，並在接下來一年內減少感染次數。其提出的機制是透過抑制mTOR來增加自噬（autophagy），同時增加抗病毒蛋白的表現。僅單次六週的mTORC1抑制即可改善免疫功能，此觀察具有重要的臨床意義，因為老年患者特別容易因流感而死亡。

source_document: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md

subject: Everolimus

context.en-US: Everolimus, a rapamycin analog (rapalog), is FDA approved for anti-seizure therapy in tuberous sclerosis complex after many years of off-label use. The EXIST-3 multicenter phase III study evaluated adjunctive everolimus in patients with treatment-resistant epilepsy due to TSC and showed significant reduction in seizure frequency, with approximately 40% of patients in the high-dose group achieving at least a 50% reduction in seizures compared to only 15% in placebo. The success reflects TSC's clearly defined molecular etiology, with highly penetrant mutations driving mTOR hyperactivation making the pathway an actionable target.
context.zh-TW: Everolimus是雷帕黴素類似物（rapalog），在多年仿單外使用後，獲FDA核准用於結節性硬化症（tuberous sclerosis complex）的抗癲癇治療。EXIST-3多中心第三期研究評估everolimus作為輔助治療用於因TSC導致難治性癲癇的患者，結果顯示癲癇發作頻率顯著降低，高劑量組約有40%的患者癲癇發作減少至少50%，而安慰劑組僅15%。此成功反映了TSC明確的分子病因學，高外顯率的突變驅動mTOR過度活化，使該路徑成為可施作的治療標靶。

source_document: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md

context.en-US: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
context.zh-TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

context.en-US: Executioner caspases are the terminal proteases of the apoptotic cascade that dismantle the cell. In aging, senescent-cell resistance to executioner-caspase killing via SCAPs is a barrier to senescent-cell clearance, linking executioner-caspase biology to senescence persistence.
context.zh-TW: 執行型 caspase 是分解細胞的細胞凋亡級聯末端蛋白酶。在衰老中，衰老細胞經由 SCAPs 對執行型 caspase 殺傷的抵抗是衰老細胞清除的障礙，將執行型 caspase 生物學與衰老持續相連結。

context.en-US: An important conclusion of the Speakman review is that exercise does not reliably increase appetite, and that in many individuals appetite is suppressed both during and for a period after exercise, an effect that can persist for up to 24 hours in some protocols. This is counter to the common belief that increased exercise necessarily drives increased food intake. When exercise does raise energy intake, the increase is generally smaller than the energy cost of the exercise, so a net negative energy balance is usually achieved. These findings support the view that exercise contributes to weight control by raising expenditure without a fully compensatory increase in intake.
context.zh-TW: Speakman綜述的一項重要結論是，運動並不會可靠地增加食慾，而且在許多個體中，食慾在運動期間及運動後一段時間內受到抑制，在某些實驗方案中此效應可持續長達24小時。這與「增加運動必然驅動更多食物攝取」的常見信念相反。當運動確實提高能量攝取時，其增加量通常小於運動的能量成本，因此通常可達到淨負能量平衡。這些發現支持以下觀點：運動透過提高消耗、而無完全補償性的攝取增加，來促進體重控制。

context.en-US: Physical exercise is proposed as a low-cost, non-pharmacological means to stimulate mitohormesis. Rodent models show that exercise stimulates a UPRmt response in muscle and other tissues, and mitokines including GDF15 and MOTS-c are markedly stimulated by exercise, suggesting the potential to exploit these factors as exercise mimetics. However, too much exercise in humans actually impairs mitochondrial function, reduces ROS production, and worsens metabolic health, underscoring that the hormetic benefit of exercise depends on an appropriate dose and adequate recovery.
context.zh-TW: 身體運動被提出作為一種低成本、非藥理學的手段來刺激粒線體毒物興奮效應（mitohormesis）。囓齒類模型顯示，運動會在肌肉及其他組織中刺激UPRmt反應，而包括GDF15與MOTS-c在內的粒線體激素（mitokine）會因運動而顯著受到刺激，顯示這些因子有潛力被開發為運動模擬劑。然而，對人類而言，過度運動實際上會損害粒線體功能、降低ROS產生並惡化代謝健康，這凸顯運動的毒物興奮效益取決於適當劑量與充足恢復。

context.en-US: Exercise is defined as planned, structured, and repetitive physical activity performed specifically to improve or maintain physical fitness, and it constitutes a subset of total physical activity, which also includes occupational activity, domestic activity, and non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT). In the energy balance framework of the Speakman review, exercise is the most flexible and controllable component of total daily energy expenditure, and its contribution to daily energy use is quantified through doubly labelled water studies. Because exercise is a voluntary component, it is the primary target of public-health interventions aimed at raising daily energy expenditure.
context.zh-TW: 運動被定義為有計畫、有結構且重複的身體活動，專門為了改善或維持體能而進行；它是總身體活動的一部分，後者還包括職業活動、家務活動與非運動性活動產熱（NEAT）。在Speakman綜述的能量平衡架構中，運動是每日總能量消耗中最具彈性且最可控制的部分，其對每日能量使用的貢獻可透過雙標水研究加以量化。由於運動是自願性組成，它是旨在提高每日能量消耗的公共衛生介入的主要目標。

context.en-US: Exercise causes a transient but significant elevation of resting metabolic rate that outlasts the exercise bout itself. A number of studies show RMR is increased for at least 24-48 hours following vigorous exercise, and residual increases are detectable even up to 3 days after a single session in some protocols. The elevation appears largely independent of the intensity of the exercise, with high-intensity interval exercise providing comparable post-exercise energy expenditure to continuous moderate exercise when matched for work. This post-exercise elevation is one mechanism by which physical activity raises daily energy expenditure beyond the direct cost of the exercise itself.
context.zh-TW: 運動會引起短暫但顯著的靜止代謝率升高，且持續時間超過運動本身。多項研究顯示，劇烈運動後至少24–48小時內RMR會升高，在某些實驗方案中，單次運動後殘餘升高甚至可偵測至3天。此升高似乎大致與運動強度無關，在總作功量匹配下，高強度間歇運動與連續中等強度運動所提供的運動後能量消耗相當。這種運動後升高是身體活動在運動本身直接成本之外提高每日能量消耗的機制之一。

context.en-US: Exercise raises total daily energy expenditure (TEE) through several mechanisms acting together: the direct metabolic cost of the exercise bout itself, the elevated resting metabolic rate and excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC) that persist after the session, and increases in nonexercise activity thermogenesis and appetite in some individuals. Speakman uses doubly labelled water studies to show that while athletes have high TEE, the contribution of exercise to TEE in moderately active people is modest in magnitude, and that an exercise-induced rise in TEE of 10-15 percent is not necessarily compensated by reduced activity in other parts of the day.
context.zh-TW: 運動透過多種機制共同提高每日總能量消耗（TEE）：運動本身的直接代謝成本、運動後持續的靜止代謝率升高與運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），以及部分個體中非運動性活動產熱與食慾的增加。Speakman利用雙標水研究顯示，雖然運動員具有高TEE，但對中等活動量的人而言，運動對TEE的貢獻幅度有限，而且運動引起的TEE上升10–15%並不一定會被一天中其他時段的活動減少所抵銷。

context.en-US: Exportin-5 is a RanGTP-dependent nuclear export receptor that transports precursor microRNA (pre-miRNA) hairpins from the nucleus to the cytoplasm. There the pre-miRNA is matured by Dicer and loaded onto Argonaute in the RISC.
context.zh-TW: Exportin-5 是 RanGTP 依賴的核輸出受體，將 microRNA 前驅物（pre-miRNA）髮夾從細胞核運送至細胞質。在那裡 pre-miRNA 由 Dicer 成熟並裝載到 RISC 中的 Argonaute。

context.en-US: Intermittent fasting and time-restricted feeding compress the eating window to 8-10 hours to allow a 14-16 hour daily fasting period, described as the simplest and most effective way to activate AMPK and mitophagy. Constant snacking and chronic overeating abolish the fasting-induced AMPK signal necessary for mitophagy. Fasting-induced mitochondrial recycling is a core mitohormetic mechanism, and stopping food intake at least 3-4 hours before sleep is highlighted as a key variable that instantly improves overnight HRV by allowing the body to focus entirely on cellular repair during sleep.
context.zh-TW: 間歇性斷食與限時進食將進食窗口壓縮至8–10小時，以達到每天14–16小時的禁食期，被描述為活化AMPK與粒線體自噬最簡單且最有效的方法。持續零嘴進食與慢性暴食會消除禁食誘發、粒線體自噬所需的AMPK訊號。禁食誘導的粒線體回收是核心的粒線體毒物興奮機制，而至少在睡前3–4小時停止進食被強調為關鍵變因，可讓身體在睡眠期間完全專注於細胞修復，立即改善夜間HRV。

context.en-US: Fat free mass (FFM) is the single best predictor of resting metabolic rate (RMR), explaining the majority of inter-individual variation in energy expenditure at rest. In the doubly labelled water and metabolic chamber studies reviewed by Speakman, FFM correlates with RMR with correlations typically above 0.7, with lean tissue contributing proportionally more than fat mass. The relationship reflects the high metabolic activity of lean tissues, especially the brain, liver, and skeletal muscle at rest. Consequently, any intervention that changes FFM, such as resistance training, is expected to alter RMR in proportion, though adaptive changes in metabolic efficiency can partially blunt this effect.
context.zh-TW: 去脂體重（FFM）是靜止代謝率（RMR）的最佳單一預測因子，可解釋靜止狀態下能量消耗的大部分個體間差異。在Speakman回顧的雙標水與代謝艙研究中，FFM與RMR的相關性通常高於0.7，且瘦肉組織的貢獻比例上高於脂肪量。此關係反映了瘦肉組織（尤其是腦、肝臟與骨骼肌）在靜止時的高代謝活性。因此，任何改變FFM的介入（如阻力訓練）預期會成比例地改變RMR，儘管代謝效率的適應性改變可能部分削弱此效應。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole is evaluated alongside conventional chemotherapeutics such as 5-Fluorouracil as a candidate repurposed anticancer agent. Its proposed complementary mechanisms raise the question of additive or synergistic benefit when combined with 5-FU-based regimens. Direct interaction data are limited, so the relationship reflects shared anticancer-interest context rather than a proven biochemical synergy.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 被視為候選的藥物再利用抗癌藥，與 5-Fluorouracil 等傳統化療藥物並列評估。其提出的互補機制引發與 5-FU 療法合併時是否具有加成或協同效益的問題。直接交互作用數據有限，故此關係反映的是共同的抗癌關注脈絡，而非經證實的生化協同。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole shows preclinical anti-glioblastoma activity via microtubule and metabolic disruption.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 通過微管和代謝破壞顯示臨床前抗膠質母細胞瘤活性。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole shows preclinical anticancer activity in RCC models.
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 在 RCC 模型中顯示臨床前抗癌活性。

context.en-US: Fenbendazole binds the colchicine site of beta-tubulin, preventing polymerization and destabilizing microtubules (Dogra & Mukhopadhyay, Sci Rep 2018).
context.zh-TW: Fenbendazole 結合 β-微管蛋白的秋水仙鹼位點，阻止聚合並 destabilizing 微管（Dogra & Mukhopadhyay, Sci Rep 2018）。

context.en-US: Vinblastine is a vinca-alkaloid microtubule-targeting agent that binds tubulin and inhibits microtubule polymerization. Both vinblastine and fenbendazole are microtubule-depolymerizing agents that arrest cells in metaphase and induce apoptosis.
context.zh-TW: Vinblastine 是結合 tubulin 並抑制微管聚合的長春花生物鹼微管靶向藥物。Vinblastine 與 fenbendazole 皆是使細胞停滯在中期並誘導凋亡的微管去聚合藥物。

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is held in check by two parallel systems: the canonical GPX4–glutathione axis and the GPX4-independent FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis. FSP1 suppresses ferroptosis by maintaining a ubiquinol radical trap at the plasma membrane, so loss of FSP1 alone is survivable only if GPX4 is intact.
context.zh-TW: 鐵死亡受到兩個平行系統的抑制：典型的 GPX4–glutathione 軸，以及不依賴 GPX4 的 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸。FSP1 透過在質膜上維持泛醇自由基陷阱來抑制鐵死亡，因此只有在 GPX4 完整時，單獨喪失 FSP1 才可存活。

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic to cells. Pam Maher, the Salk senior author, discovered the pathway and named it (originally 'oxytosis') in 2001. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that can stave off ferroptosis. Ferroptosis has been increasingly linked to neurodegeneration - Maher's lab recently reported that chronic iron overexposure in neurons makes them less resilient over time and more vulnerable to neurodegeneration - and targeting the pathway has become a promising therapeutic strategy for age-related diseases alongside senescence research.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積對細胞產生毒性。Salk研究所的資深作者Pam Maher於2001年發現此途徑並加以命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。Ferroptosis日益與神經退化相關——Maher的實驗室近期報告指出，神經元長期過度暴露於鐵會使其隨時間韌性下降，並更容易發生神經退化——而標靶此途徑已與衰老研究一同成為年齡相關疾病的具前景治療策略。

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is a regulated cell death pathway driven by the toxic accumulation of lipid peroxides. Cells die in ferroptosis when they lose the ability to regulate fats, and polyunsaturated fatty acids in membranes become the substrates for peroxidative damage. Healthy cells keep lipid peroxides at steady levels with the help of glutathione, an antioxidant that staves off ferroptosis. The pathway is iron-dependent and has been linked to aging and neurodegeneration, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease. Understanding lipid-peroxide accumulation as the central executioner mechanism explains why membrane lipid remodeling - such as that caused by acid ceramidase - can sensitize cells to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: Ferroptosis是一種受調控的細胞死亡途徑，由脂質過氧化物的毒性累積所驅動。當細胞失去調節脂肪的能力時，便會死於ferroptosis，而膜中的多元不飽和脂肪酸成為過氧化損傷的受質。健康細胞在麩胱甘肽（一種可抵禦ferroptosis的抗氧化劑）的幫助下，將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平。此途徑依賴鐵，並已被連結至老化與神經退化，包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症。理解脂質過氧化物累積作為核心執行者機制，說明了為何膜脂質重塑——例如由酸性神經醯胺酶（acid ceramidase）所引起的重塑——能使細胞對ferroptosis敏感化。

source_document: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md

context.en-US: The Fenton reaction, in which iron reduces hydrogen peroxide to generate hydroxyl radicals, is a primary driver of oxidative stress. Iron-dependent Fenton chemistry contributes to neurodegeneration in Parkinson's disease, and iron accumulation sensitizes neurons to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: 芬頓反應（Fenton reaction）中鐵還原過氧化氫產生羥基自由基，是氧化壓力的主要驅動者。鐵依賴的芬頓化學促成帕金森氏症的神經退化，而鐵累積使神經元對 ferroptosis 敏感。

subject: Ferroptosis

context.en-US: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
context.zh-TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

context.en-US: FGF21 is essential for the longevity and many of the metabolic benefits of protein restriction. Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR, while mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30-40% lifespan extension, identifying FGF21 as the critical downstream mediator. FGF21 promotes energy expenditure in part through UCP1-dependent thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, acting in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue. It also regulates lipid homeostasis, reduces circulating triglycerides, mediates PR effects on cellular senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue, and reduces hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis in obese models.
context.zh-TW: FGF21對於蛋白質限制的長壽效應及其許多代謝益處至關重要。Fgf21基因剔除小鼠在PR下並不會活得更久，而過度表現Fgf21的小鼠則顯示約30–40%的壽命延長，使FGF21被確認為關鍵的下游媒介者。FGF21部分透過UCP1依賴性的白色脂肪組織產熱性米色化促進能量消耗，其作用發生於腦中並經由交感神經訊號傳遞，同時也增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。它還調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯、中介PR對白色脂肪組織中細胞衰老與發炎的效應，並在肥胖模型中減少肝臟脂肪變性、發炎與纖維化。

context.en-US: FGF21 induces thermogenesis and promotes energy expenditure through UCP1-dependent mechanisms. FGF21 promotes thermogenic beiging of white adipose tissue, with protein restriction stimulating WAT beiging via FGF21 action in the brain through sympathetic signaling, and PR similarly increases thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue via an FGF21-dependent mechanism. These effects drive the increased energy expenditure observed with protein restriction and contribute to its metabolic benefits including reduced body weight and adiposity despite increased food intake. FGF21 also regulates lipid homeostasis, reducing circulating triglycerides, and mediates PR effects on senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue.
context.zh-TW: FGF21透過UCP1依賴性機制誘發產熱並促進能量消耗。FGF21促進白色脂肪組織的產熱性米色化（beiging），而蛋白質限制會經由腦中FGF21的作用、透過交感神經訊號刺激WAT米色化；PR同樣透過FGF21依賴性機制增加棕色脂肪組織的產熱。這些效應驅動了蛋白質限制所觀察到的能量消耗增加，並促成其代謝益處，包括在食物攝取增加的情況下仍降低體重與脂肪量。FGF21也調節脂質恆定、降低循環三酸甘油酯，並中介PR對白色脂肪組織中衰老與發炎的效應。

subject: FIS1

context.en-US: FIS1 is a tail-anchored outer mitochondrial membrane protein that functions as a receptor for DRP1, helping to recruit the fission machinery to mitochondria. In yeast, the FIS1 ortholog Fis1p is the main membrane anchor for the Dnm1p fission GTPase, whereas in mammalian cells FIS1 plays a more accessory role alongside MFF, MID49, and MID51, and may also mediate non-DRP1 functions such as recruiting proteasomal and autophagic machinery to mitochondria. Overexpression of FIS1 fragments mitochondria, whereas FIS1 knockdown produces elongated networks, confirming its pro-fission role, although its relative importance varies between cell types and conditions.
context.zh-TW: FIS1是一種錨定於粒線體外膜的蛋白質（tail-anchored protein），作為DRP1的受體，協助將分裂機製招募至粒線體。在酵母菌中，FIS1的直系同源物Fis1p是分裂GTP酶Dnm1p的主要膜錨點；而在哺乳類細胞中，FIS1則與MFF、MID49及MID51一同扮演較輔助性的角色，也可能中介非DRP1的功能，例如將蛋白酶體與自噬機製招募至粒線體。FIS1過度表現會使粒線體碎裂，而FIS1基因敲低則產生延長狀的網絡，證實其促分裂作用，儘管其相對重要性會因細胞類型與條件而異。

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin shows broad anti-cancer activity against cell lines derived from lung, colon, breast, prostate, liver, melanoma, bladder, and leukemia. It inhibits cancer cell proliferation by arresting the cell cycle at G1 or G2/M phase, induces apoptosis through the intrinsic mitochondrial pathway with activation of caspases and modulation of Bcl-2 family proteins, and suppresses invasion and metastasis by inhibiting matrix metalloproteinases and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Fisetin also sensitizes tumor cells to conventional chemotherapeutics. Its anti-cancer efficacy in animal models, however, has been limited by the low concentrations achieved after oral dosing.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin對源自肺、結腸、乳、前列腺、肝、黑色素瘤、膀胱與白血病的細胞株展現廣泛的抗癌活性。它透過將細胞週期阻斷於G1或G2/M期來抑制癌細胞增殖，經由內在粒線體途徑誘發凋亡（伴隨caspase活化與Bcl-2家族蛋白調節），並透過抑制基質金屬蛋白酶與上皮-間質轉換來抑制侵襲與轉移。Fisetin也會使腫瘤細胞對傳統化療藥物敏感化。然而，其動物模型中的抗癌效力受到口服給藥後僅達低濃度所限制。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin improves glucose homeostasis in experimental diabetes by enhancing insulin sensitivity and reducing hepatic glucose output. In diabetic rodents it lowers fasting blood glucose and glycated hemoglobin, reduces insulin resistance, and protects pancreatic beta cells, in part through its antioxidant activity and activation of AMPK signaling in liver and muscle. The review notes these metabolic benefits depend on adequate systemic exposure, which the oral delivery of unformulated fisetin may not achieve, further emphasizing the need for bioavailability-improving formulations to realize its therapeutic potential in humans.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin透過提高胰島素敏感性與減少肝臟葡萄糖輸出，改善實驗性糖尿病的葡萄糖恆定。在糖尿病囓齒類中，它降低空腹血糖與糖化血色素、減少胰島素阻抗，並保護胰臟β細胞，部分透過其抗氧化活性與活化肝臟及肌肉中的AMPK訊號。該綜述指出，這些代謝益處取決於足夠的全身暴露量，而未經配方處理的fisetin口服給藥可能無法達成，進一步強調需要能改善生體可用率的配方，才能實現其於人體的治療潛力。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is a potent antioxidant that scavenges reactive oxygen species (ROS) and reactive nitrogen species and stimulates endogenous antioxidant defenses including Nrf2-dependent expression of heme oxygenase-1, catalase, and superoxide dismutase. Its multiple hydroxyl groups allow it to donate electrons to quench free radicals and chelate metal ions that catalyze oxidative damage. The anti-oxidative action of fisetin underpins its protective effects in neuronal, cardiac, hepatic, and renal models of oxidative stress, and is considered a core mechanism shared with other polyphenols in its protective pharmacology.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin是一種強效抗氧化劑，可清除活性氧物種（ROS）與活性氮物種，並刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，包括Nrf2依賴性的血基質氧化酶-1（heme oxygenase-1）、過氧化氫酶與超氧化物歧化酶表現。其多個羥基使其能捐贈電子以淬滅自由基，並螯合催化氧化損傷的金屬離子。fisetin的抗氧化作用是其於神經、心臟、肝臟與腎臟氧化壓力模型中保護效應的基礎，並被認為是其保護性藥理學中與其他多酚類共有的核心機制。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin targets the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL, which is overexpressed in many cancer cells and in senescent cells as a survival mechanism. By inhibiting Bcl-xL and the related pro-survival pathways PI3K/Akt, fisetin lowers the threshold for apoptosis, promoting the death of senescent cells and chemoresistant cancer cells. The reliance of senescent cells on Bcl-xL is precisely the vulnerability that senolytics exploit, and fisetin's capacity to inhibit Bcl-xL is a key mechanistic basis for its senolytic activity and for its ability to sensitize tumors to existing therapies.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin標靶抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL，該蛋白在許多癌細胞與衰老細胞中作為存活機制而過度表現。透過抑制Bcl-xL及相關的促存活途徑PI3K/Akt，fisetin降低了凋亡的閾值，促進衰老細胞與化療抗性癌細胞的死亡。衰老細胞對Bcl-xL的依賴正是senolytic所利用的弱點，而fisetin抑制Bcl-xL的能力是其senolytic活性及其使腫瘤對既有療法敏感化的關鍵機制基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin suffers from intrinsically poor bioavailability that restricts its clinical translation. Its water solubility is very low (below 10 ug/mL), and the compound is sensitive to light, heat, and oxidative degradation. After oral administration fisetin is rapidly metabolized in the gut and liver to glucuronide and sulfate conjugates, so systemic exposure of the parent compound is minimal. The review documents that oral fisetin has short half-life and low plasma concentrations, and it attributes these problems to the BCS class II/IV characteristics of fisetin, motivating the development of macro- and nano-formulations to improve its absorption.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin受到本質上較差的生體可用率所苦，這限制了其臨床轉譯。其水溶性非常低（低於10 ug/mL），且此化合物對光、熱與氧化降解敏感。口服給藥後，fisetin在腸道與肝臟中迅速代謝為葡萄糖醛酸與硫酸接合物，因此母體化合物的全身暴露量極小。該綜述記載口服fisetin的半衰期短、血漿濃度低，並將這些問題歸因於fisetin的BCS第II/IV類特性，促使開發巨觀與奈米配方以改善其吸收。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin clears senescent cells from tissues, reducing the burden of cellular senescence that accumulates with aging. In naturally aged and progeroid mice, oral fisetin lowered the number of p16INK4a-positive and SA-beta-galactosidase-positive cells in adipose tissue, skin, and other organs, and improved age-related tissue pathology. By removing senescent cells, fisetin also reduces the pro-inflammatory secretory phenotype they maintain, which contributes to age-related chronic inflammation. The capacity of fisetin to reduce cellular senescence in vivo is the defining action of its senolytic pharmacology and the basis for its proposed healthspan benefits.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin清除組織中的衰老細胞，減輕隨老化累積的細胞衰老負擔。在自然老化與早衰（progeroid）小鼠中，口服fisetin降低了脂肪組織、皮膚及其他器官中p16INK4a陽性與SA-β-半乳糖苷酶陽性細胞的數量，並改善年齡相關的組織病理。透過移除衰老細胞，fisetin也減少了它們所維持的促發炎分泌表型（SASP），此表型促成年齡相關的慢性發炎。Fisetin在體內減少細胞衰老的能力是其senolytic藥理學的定義性作用，也是其健康壽命效益的提出基礎。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin (3,3',4',7-tetrahydroxyflavone) is a natural flavonoid of the flavonol subclass found in strawberries, apples, persimmons, onions, and cucumbers, with strawberries being the richest dietary source. It has the molecular formula C15H10O6 and a molecular weight of 286.24 g/mol. Fisetin is widely studied as a senolytic agent, and its anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and neuroprotective activities are reported in numerous in vitro and in vivo studies. Despite its broad pharmacological potential, fisetin has extremely poor aqueous solubility, which severely limits its oral bioavailability.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin（3,3',4',7-四羥基黃酮）是黃酮醇亞類的天然黃酮類化合物，存在於草莓、蘋果、柿子、洋蔥與黃瓜中，其中草莓是最豐富的膳食來源。其分子式為C15H10O6，分子量為286.24 g/mol。Fisetin被廣泛研究作為senolytic藥物，其抗氧化、抗發炎、抗癌、抗糖尿病與神經保護活性在眾多體外與體內研究中均有報告。儘管藥理潛力廣泛，fisetin的水溶性極差，嚴重限制其口服生體可用率。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin suppresses inflammation through multiple converging mechanisms. It inhibits the NF-kB pathway, reducing the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, and it inhibits cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and inducible nitric oxide synthase, decreasing prostaglandin and nitric oxide levels. It also blocks the STAT1 and STAT3 signaling cascades that amplify inflammatory gene expression. These anti-inflammatory actions contribute to fisetin's protective effects in arthritis, colitis, acute lung injury, and neuroinflammation models, and the anti-inflammatory activity is preserved in some nanoformulations of the compound.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin透過多種匯聚機制抑制發炎。它抑制NF-kB途徑，減少TNF-alpha、IL-1beta與IL-6等促發炎細胞激素的產生，並抑制環氧合酶-2（COX-2）與誘導型一氧化氮合酶，降低前列腺素與一氧化氮水平。它也阻斷放大發炎基因表現的STAT1與STAT3訊號級聯。這些抗發炎作用促成fisetin在關節炎、結腸炎、急性肺損傷與神經發炎模型中的保護效應，且此抗發炎活性在該化合物的一些奈米配方中得以保留。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is incompletely and variably absorbed after oral administration due to its low water solubility and rapid first-pass metabolism by intestinal and hepatic conjugating enzymes. Bioavailability studies report low and highly variable plasma fisetin concentrations after oral dosing, with most of the absorbed compound present as glucuronide and sulfate conjugates rather than the parent aglycone. The review identifies this limited oral absorption as the principal barrier to clinical translation of fisetin's broad preclinical pharmacology, and the majority of the formulation strategies it discusses are specifically aimed at increasing the fraction of the orally administered dose that reaches the systemic circulation unchanged.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin口服給藥後的吸收不完全且變異大，原因在於其低水溶性，以及腸道與肝臟接合酶快速的首次通過代謝。生體可用率研究報告指出，口服給藥後血漿fisetin濃度低且高度變異，大部分被吸收的化合物以葡萄糖醛酸（glucuronide）與硫酸（sulfate）接合物形式存在，而非母體苷元（aglycone）。該綜述將此有限的口服吸收認定為fisetin廣泛臨床前藥理學轉譯的主要障礙，而其討論的大部分配方策略均專門針對提高口服劑量中未經改變即到達全身循環的比例。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin has extremely low water solubility, reported in the range of a few micrograms per milliliter, which classifies it as a Biopharmaceutics Classification System (BCS) class II or IV drug. The low solubility, combined with poor permeability in some assessments and extensive intestinal and hepatic first-pass metabolism, results in low and erratic oral bioavailability. Because dissolution is the rate-limiting step for oral absorption, much of the formulation research described in the review aims to increase the dissolution rate and apparent solubility of fisetin, using approaches such as solid dispersions, cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, and nanocrystals.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin的水溶性極低，報告值約為每毫升數微克，使其被歸類為生物藥劑學分類系統（BCS）第II類或第IV類藥物。低溶解度加上部分評估中較差的通透性，以及廣泛的腸道與肝臟首次通過代謝，導致低且不穩定的口服生體可用率。由於溶離是口服吸收的速率決定步驟，該綜述所述的大部分配方研究旨在提高fisetin的溶離速率與表觀溶解度，使用固體分散、環糊精包合物與奈米晶體等方法。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin exerts neuroprotective effects that are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and direct signaling actions in neurons. It protects cultured neurons from oxidative and excitotoxic insults, and in animal models of ischemia and Parkinson's disease it reduces neuronal loss and improves motor function. Fisetin also acts as a cognitive enhancer, improving learning and memory in healthy rodents through modulation of ERK-CREB signaling and by promoting synaptic plasticity, and it has been proposed as a candidate for Alzheimer's disease based on its ability to reduce beta-amyloid aggregation and tau pathology. These effects motivate delivery strategies aimed at improving brain exposure.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin發揮的神經保護效應歸因於其在神經元中的抗氧化、抗發炎與直接訊號傳導作用。它能保護培養神經元免受氧化與興奮性毒性傷害，且在缺血與帕金森氏症動物模型中減少神經元損失並改善運動功能。Fisetin也作為認知增強劑，透過調節ERK-CREB訊號並促進突觸可塑性，改善健康囓齒類的學習與記憶；基於其減少β-類澱粉蛋白聚集與tau病理的能力，也被提出作為阿茲海默症的候選藥物。這些效應推動了旨在提高腦部暴露量的給藥策略。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin regulates the PI3K/Akt pathway, which is central to both its anti-cancer and senolytic activities. In cancer cells, fisetin suppresses Akt phosphorylation and downstream mTOR signaling, reducing proliferation and survival, whereas in the context of senescence, fisetin's inhibition of PI3K/Akt removes a survival signal that senescent cells rely on, triggering their elimination. Fisetin's modulation of this pathway is dose-dependent and context-dependent, and it also crosstalks with MAPK/ERK signaling. Nanoformulations designed to raise fisetin exposure are expected to amplify these pathway-level effects by delivering higher intracellular concentrations.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin調節PI3K/Akt途徑，此途徑對其抗癌與senolytic活性均屬核心。在癌細胞中，fisetin抑制Akt磷酸化及下游mTOR訊號，減少增殖與存活；而在衰老的情境中，fisetin對PI3K/Akt的抑制移除了衰老細胞賴以存活的存活訊號，觸發其清除。Fisetin對此途徑的調節具有劑量依賴性與情境依賴性，並與MAPK/ERK訊號發生交叉對話。旨在提高fisetin暴露量的奈米配方，預期可透過遞送更高的細胞內濃度來放大這些途徑層級的效應。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin is among the most extensively studied naturally occurring senolytics. It selectively eliminates senescent cells by inhibiting key pro-survival pathways, including the PI3K/Akt and Bcl-xL pathways that senescent cells depend on to resist apoptosis. In aged mice, a short course of oral fisetin reduced senescent cell burden in multiple tissues, extended healthspan and median lifespan, and alleviated age-related dysfunction. This senolytic activity distinguishes fisetin from many flavonoids and has driven its evaluation in human clinical trials for osteoarthritis, frailty, and other age-related conditions, though pharmacokinetic limitations remain a central obstacle.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin是研究最廣泛的天然衰老細胞清除劑（senolytic）之一。它透過抑制衰老細胞賴以抵抗凋亡的關鍵促存活途徑（包括PI3K/Akt與Bcl-xL途徑），選擇性地清除衰老細胞。在老年小鼠中，短期口服fisetin可降低多種組織中的衰老細胞負擔、延長健康壽命（healthspan）與中位壽命，並緩解年齡相關的功能失調。此senolytic活性使fisetin有別於許多黃酮類化合物，並驅動其進入針對骨關節炎、衰弱及其他年齡相關疾病的人類臨床試驗，儘管藥代動力學限制仍是核心障礙。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Fisetin belongs to the pharmacological class of senolytics, agents that selectively kill senescent cells. Senolytics, exemplified by fisetin and dasatinib plus quercetin, exploit the reliance of senescent cells on anti-apoptotic survival networks. Fisetin's senolytic profile was identified in screening studies and validated in mouse models where it cleared senescent cells in adipose tissue, bone marrow, and other organs and extended healthspan. Because senescent cell accumulation drives tissue dysfunction and age-related disease, fisetin is now being evaluated in human trials, and its classification as a senolytic frames the therapeutic rationale for improving its bioavailability.
context.zh-TW: Fisetin屬於senolytic（衰老細胞清除劑）藥理學類別，即選擇性殺死衰老細胞的藥物。以fisetin及dasatinib加quercetin為代表的senolytic，利用衰老細胞對抗凋亡存活網絡的依賴。Fisetin的senolytic特性在篩選研究中被識別，並在小鼠模型中獲得驗證：它清除脂肪組織、骨髓及其他器官中的衰老細胞，並延長健康壽命。由於衰老細胞累積驅動組織功能失調與年齡相關疾病，fisetin目前正在人體試驗中評估，而其作為senolytic的分類也為改善其生體可用率的治療學理提供框架。

source_document: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md

subject: Fisetin

context.en-US: Once absorbed, fisetin is extensively conjugated by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) and sulfotransferases in the intestinal epithelium and liver, producing fisetin glucuronide and fisetin sulfate metabolites that circulate in the plasma. Because these conjugates have reduced biological activity and are rapidly excreted via bile and urine, the parent aglycone fisetin reaches only low concentrations in tissues. The extent of this phase II metabolism is a primary cause of fisetin's poor oral bioavailability and short plasma half-life, and it is one reason most preclinical efficacy studies have used intraperitoneal injection rather than oral dosing.
context.zh-TW: 一旦被吸收，fisetin會被腸道上皮與肝臟中的UDP-葡萄糖醛酸轉移酶（UGT）與磺基轉移酶廣泛接合，產生在血漿中循環的fisetin葡萄糖醛酸與fisetin硫酸代謝物。由於這些接合物生物活性降低，且會經由膽汁與尿液迅速排泄，母體苷元fisetin在組織中僅達到低濃度。此第二相反應的程度是fisetin口服生體可用率差與血漿半衰期短的主要原因，也是多數臨床前療效研究採用腹腔注射而非口服給藥的原因之一。

context.en-US: Rapalogs inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. FKBP12 is therefore the essential cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage and suppress mTORC1 signaling.
context.zh-TW: Rapalog 透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面來抑制 mTORC1。因此 FKBP12 是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與並抑制 mTORC1 訊號所需的必需輔因子。

context.en-US: FKBP12 binds the FKBP12-FRB interface of mTOR and is the cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage the mTOR complexes. While the canonical target is mTORC1, FKBP12-mediated engagement is also relevant to mTORC2 regulation by rapalogs.
context.zh-TW: FKBP12 結合 mTOR 的 FKBP12-FRB 介面，是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與 mTOR 複合體的輔因子。雖然典型目標是 mTORC1，FKBP12 介導的參與也與 rapalog 對 mTORC2 的調節相關。

context.en-US: FKBP12 is the cellular binding partner through which rapamycin and rapalogs inhibit mTORC1. The rapamycin-FKBP12 complex binds the FRB domain of mTOR kinase, and FKBP12 is the bridge node for mTORC1/mTORC2 inhibition.
context.zh-TW: FKBP12 是 rapamycin 與 rapalog 用以抑制 mTORC1 的細胞結合夥伴。Rapamycin-FKBP12 複合體結合 mTOR 激酶的 FRB 結構域，FKBP12 是 mTORC1/mTORC2 抑制的橋接節點。

context.en-US: Flubendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic structurally related to fenbendazole. It inhibits microtubule function through a mechanism distinct from vinca alkaloids and displays preclinical activity in leukemia and myeloma models, with reported synergism with microtubule-targeting agents.
context.zh-TW: Flubendazole 是與 fenbendazole 結構相關的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥。它透過不同於長春花生物鹼的機制抑制微管功能，在白血病與骨髓瘤模型中表現臨床前活性，並有與微管靶向藥物協同的報導。

context.en-US: Frailty is a geriatric syndrome of reduced physiological reserve strongly associated with chronic low-grade inflammation (inflammaging). Interventions that lower background inflammation may mitigate frailty progression.
context.zh-TW: 衰弱（frailty）是生理儲備下降的老年症候群，與慢性低度發炎（inflammaging）密切相關。能降低背景發炎的介入措施可能有助於緩解衰弱進展。

context.en-US: By regenerating ubiquinol (CoQ10H2) at the plasma membrane, FSP1 maintains a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that halts the propagation of phospholipid peroxyl radicals, suppressing ferroptotic cell death independently of glutathione. It fully rescues lethality in GPX4-null cells.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 在質膜上重新生成泛醇（CoQ10H2），維持脂溶性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑，中止磷脂過氧自由基的傳播，從而不依賴谷胱甘肽地抑制鐵死亡性細胞死亡。它在 GPX4 缺失的細胞中能完全挽救致死效應。

context.en-US: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
context.zh-TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

context.en-US: FSP1 and GPX4 guard the same outcome — suppression of lethal lipid peroxidation — through independent chemistries and cofactor requirements. GPX4 is GSH/selenium-dependent and repairs existing phospholipid hydroperoxides; FSP1 is GSH-independent and maintains a preventive radical trap. Loss of either axis alone is survivable if the other is intact, so combined inhibition (e.g., iFSP1 + a GPX4 inhibitor) is strongly synergistic. || GPX4 and FSP1 both suppress lethal lipid peroxidation but via independent chemistries: GPX4 is GSH/selenium-dependent and repairs existing phospholipid hydroperoxides, whereas FSP1 is GSH-independent and maintains a preventive ubiquinol radical trap. Loss of either axis alone is tolerable if the other is intact, so combined inhibition is strongly synergistic.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 與 GPX4 守護同一結果——抑制致死的脂質過氧化——但透過各自獨立的化學機制與輔因子需求。GPX4 依賴 GSH/硒並修復既有的磷脂氫過氧化物；FSP1 不依賴 GSH 並維持預防性的自由基陷阱。只要另一軸完整，單獨喪失任一軸都可存活，因此同時抑制兩者（例如 iFSP1 加上 GPX4 抑制劑）具有強烈協同效應。 || GPX4 與 FSP1 都抑制致死的脂質過氧化，但機制各自獨立：GPX4 依賴 GSH/硒並修復既有的磷脂氫過氧化物，而 FSP1 不依賴 GSH 並維持預防性的泛醇自由基陷阱。只要另一軸完整，單獨喪失任一軸都可耐受，因此同時抑制兩者具有強烈協同效應。

context.en-US: iFSP1, the first-in-class FSP1 inhibitor (IC50 ≈ 103 nM), binds human FSP1 at a pocket centered on residue F360 and blocks its NAD(P)H-dependent reduction of ubiquinone to ubiquinol, removing the GPX4-independent radical trap. Alone it is often insufficient in high-GPX4 cells but strongly synergizes with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibition to trigger ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: iFSP1 是第一個 FSP1 抑制劑（IC50 ≈ 103 nM），結合於人類 FSP1 以 F360 殘基為中心的口袋，鎖定並阻斷其依賴 NAD(P)H 將泛醌還原為泛醇的活性，移除不依賴 GPX4 的自由基陷阱。單獨使用在 GPX4 高表現細胞中往往不足，但與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併時強烈協同誘發鐵死亡。

context.en-US: The substrate for FSP1 — ubiquinone/CoQ10 — is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Perturbations that suppress mevalonate output toward cholesterol (e.g., statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) starve FSP1 of its ubiquinone substrate, collapsing the FSP1 axis and predicting ferroptosis sensitivity. This makes the mevalonate pathway intersect ferroptosis at two nodes: selenocysteine-tRNA maturation for GPX4 and CoQ10 supply for FSP1.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 的受質——泛醌/CoQ10——是甲羥戊酸（mevalonate）路徑的非固醇產物。抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的擾動（例如 statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會使 FSP1 缺乏泛醌受質，瓦解 FSP1 軸並預示鐵死亡敏感性。這使甲羥戊酸路徑在兩個節點與鐵死亡交會：GPX4 所需的硒半胱氨酸-tRNA 成熟，以及 FSP1 所需的 CoQ10 供應。

context.en-US: FSP1's NAD(P)H-dependent ubiquinone oxidoreductase activity draws reducing equivalents from NAD(P)H to regenerate ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), the lipophilic radical trap that halts lipid peroxidation. NAD(P)H is therefore the obligate electron donor for the GPX4-independent FSP1 axis.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 依賴 NAD(P)H 的泛醌氧化還原酶活性，從 NAD(P)H 取得還原當量以重新生成泛醇（CoQ10H2）——這個脂溶性自由基陷阱能中止脂質過氧化。因此 NAD(P)H 是 FSP1 這條不依賴 GPX4 的路徑所必需的電子供體。

context.en-US: FSP1 carries an N-terminal N-myristoylation motif that recruits it to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, positioning the enzyme precisely where phospholipid peroxidation is initiated and propagated. Membrane association is essential for its ferroptosis-suppressive function.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 帶有 N 端 N-肉豆蔻酰化（myristoylation）基序，將其招募至質膜內葉，使酵素精確定位在磷脂過氧化起始與傳播的位置。膜結合對其抑制鐵死亡的功能不可或缺。

context.en-US: N-myristoylation of FSP1 tethers the enzyme to the inner leaflet of the plasma membrane, positioning its ubiquinone-reductase activity exactly where phospholipid peroxidation is initiated and propagated — essential for its ferroptosis-suppressive function.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 的 N-肉豆蔻酰化將酵素繫留於質膜內葉，使其泛醌還原酶活性精確定位在磷脂過氧化起始與傳播之處——對其抑制鐵死亡的功能不可或缺。

context.en-US: PPARα positively drives FSP1 expression; PPARα activators such as fenofibrate and bezafibrate raise FSP1 levels and increase ferroptosis resistance. Conversely, the MDM2/MDMX complex suppresses FSP1 by inhibiting PPARα activity, lowering FSP1 and sensitizing cells to ferroptosis.
context.zh-TW: PPARα 正向驅動 FSP1 的表現；PPARα 活化劑如 fenofibrate 與 bezafibrate 會提升 FSP1 含量並增加鐵死亡抗性。相反地，MDM2/MDMX 複合物透過抑制 PPARα 活性來壓低 FSP1，使細胞對鐵死亡更敏感。

context.en-US: FSP1 catalyzes the reduction of oxidized ubiquinone (CoQ10) to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2) at the expense of NAD(P)H, regenerating the membrane-embedded radical-trapping antioxidant pool that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains during lipid peroxidation. This is mechanistically distinct from GPX4, which consumes Glutathione to repair pre-formed phospholipid hydroperoxides.
context.zh-TW: FSP1 利用 NAD(P)H 將氧化的泛醌（CoQ10）還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），重新生成膜內的自由基捕獲抗氧化劑池，終止脂質過氧化過程中的磷脂過氧自由基鏈。這在機制上不同於 GPX4——後者消耗 Glutathione 來修復已形成的磷脂氫過氧化物。

context.en-US: A 2022 extension (Mishima et al., Nature 608:778) showed FSP1 is also a warfarin-resistant vitamin K reductase: it reduces vitamin K to its hydroquinone (VKH2), sustaining a non-canonical vitamin K redox cycle that, like the CoQ10 cycle, supplies a reduced radical-trapping antioxidant independent of GPX4. This broadens FSP1 into a general quinone-reductase ferroptosis suppressor and explains its antidotal activity against warfarin poisoning.
context.zh-TW: 2022 年的延伸研究（Mishima et al., Nature 608:778）顯示 FSP1 也是一種抗 warfarin 的維生素 K 還原酶：它將維生素 K 還原為其氫醌（VKH2），維持一個非典型的維生素 K 氧化還原循環，如同 CoQ10 循環一般，提供不依賴 GPX4 的還原型自由基捕獲抗氧化劑。這將 FSP1 擴展為廣義的醌還原酶型鐵死亡抑制劑，也解釋了它對 warfarin 中毒的解毒活性。

subject: FUNDC1

context.en-US: FUNDC1 (FUN14 domain containing 1) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that serves as a mitophagy receptor for hypoxia-induced mitophagy, interacting directly with LC3 after dephosphorylation by phosphoglycerate mutase 5. ULK1 interacts with FUNDC1 and phosphorylates it at serine 17, enhancing FUNDC1 binding to LC3, and FUNDC1 interacts with OPA1 and DRP1 in a manner regulated by serine 13 phosphorylation during hypoxia or membrane potential loss. DRP1 can interact with overexpressed FUNDC1 to facilitate mitochondrial fragmentation and Parkin-mediated mitophagy.
context.zh-TW: FUNDC1（FUN14 domain containing 1）是一種粒線體外膜蛋白，作為缺氧誘發粒線體自噬的受體，在經磷酸甘油酸變位酶5（phosphoglycerate mutase 5）去磷酸化後直接與LC3交互作用。ULK1與FUNDC1交互作用並在絲胺酸17（serine 17）處使其磷酸化，增強FUNDC1與LC3的結合；而在缺氧或膜電位喪失期間，FUNDC1與OPA1及DRP1的交互作用則受絲胺酸13磷酸化調節。DRP1可與過度表現的FUNDC1交互作用，以促進粒線體碎裂與Parkin介導的粒線體自噬。

context.en-US: Gasdermin E (GSDME, formerly DFNA5) is cleaved by executioner caspase-3, releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain. In GSDME-high cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 converts the death program from quiet apoptosis into lytic, inflammatory pyroptosis; in GSDME-low settings GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3. PINK1-mediated mitophagy suppresses caspase-3/GSDME-dependent pyroptosis in postoperative cognitive dysfunction, tying mitophagy competence to which death modality prevails.
context.zh-TW: Gasdermin E（GSDME，舊稱 DFNA5）會被執行者 Caspase-3 切割，釋出其成孔的 N 端片段。在 GSDME 高表達的細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 會將死亡程序由安靜的細胞凋亡轉為裂解性、發炎性的焦亡；在 GSDME 低表達時，GSDME 反而位於 Caspase-3 的上游。PINK1 介導的粒線體自噬會抑制術後認知功能障礙中 Caspase-3/GSDME 依賴的焦亡，將粒線體自噬能力與何種死亡模式勝出連結起來。

context.en-US: GCN2 is an evolutionarily conserved stress-responsive serine/threonine kinase activated by amino acid restriction through uncharged tRNAs, as well as by ribosome stalling and collision. Activated GCN2 phosphorylates eIF2alpha, which suppresses global protein synthesis while selectively promoting translation of ATF4, a key transcription factor that activates stress response and autophagy genes. This selective translation of ATF4 is a central feature of the integrated stress response engaged during protein restriction. Genetic evidence confirms GCN2's importance: Drosophila lacking Gcn2 die when amino acids are restricted, deletion of Gcn2 in yeast blocks dietary restriction lifespan extension, and GCN2 overexpression extends lifespan in both organisms.
context.zh-TW: GCN2是一種演化上保守、對壓力有反應的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，由胺基酸限制透過未帶電荷的tRNA活化，也可由核醣體停滯與碰撞活化。活化的GCN2使eIF2alpha磷酸化，抑制整體蛋白質合成，同時選擇性地促進ATF4的轉譯；ATF4是活化壓力反應與自噬基因的關鍵轉錄因子。ATF4的選擇性轉譯是蛋白質限制期間所啟動的整合性壓力反應（integrated stress response）的核心特徵。遺傳證據確認了GCN2的重要性：缺乏Gcn2的果蠅在胺基酸受限時會死亡，酵母菌中刪除Gcn2會阻斷飲食限制的壽命延長，而GCN2過度表現則在兩種生物體中均延長壽命。

context.en-US: Tryptophan depletion caused by IDO1 activity activates the GCN2 stress kinase, which leads to cell cycle arrest, anergy, or apoptosis in effector T cells, since tryptophan is essential for T cell proliferation. This amino-acid starvation response is one of the two main mechanisms of IDO1-mediated immunosuppression, the other being kynurenine/aryl hydrocarbon receptor signaling that promotes regulatory T cells. Together these pathways create an immunosuppressive microenvironment exploited by tumors, and this biology is the rationale for IDO1 inhibitors in immuno-oncology: blocking tryptophan catabolism is intended to relieve GCN2-driven T cell suppression and restore antitumor immunity.
context.zh-TW: IDO1活性引起的色胺酸耗竭會活化GCN2壓力激酶，導致效應T細胞的細胞週期停滯、無反應性（anergy）或凋亡，因為色胺酸對T細胞增殖不可或缺。此胺基酸飢餓反應是IDO1介導免疫抑制的兩大主要機制之一，另一機制是促進調節性T細胞的犬尿胺酸/芳香烴受體（aryl hydrocarbon receptor）訊號。這些途徑共同形成腫瘤所利用的免疫抑制微環境，而此生物學正是免疫腫瘤學中IDO1抑制劑的學理依據：阻斷色胺酸分解代謝旨在解除GCN2驅動的T細胞抑制，並恢復抗腫瘤免疫。

context.en-US: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
context.zh-TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

context.en-US: Classic pharmacological geroprotectors include the mTOR inhibitor rapamycin and its rapalogs, alongside metformin and senolytics. Many act through overlapping nutrient-sensing axes and engage autophagy.
context.zh-TW: 經典的藥理學延緩衰老劑包括 mTOR 抑制劑 rapamycin 及其 rapalog，以及 metformin 與 senolytic。許多透過重疊的營養感知軸作用並啟動自噬。

context.en-US: Ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice. In the aged thymus, ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease and correlate with functional thymic involution and generalized elevated inflammation, implying that the decline of these hormones contributes to the age-associated inflammatory milieu. In addition to suppressing inflammation, ghrelin has a stimulatory effect on thymus cellularity, increasing early thymic progenitors and recent thymic emigrants.
context.zh-TW: Ghrelin減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應。在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平下降，並與功能性胸腺退化及全面性發炎升高相關，顯示這些激素的衰退促成了年齡相關的發炎環境。除了抑制發炎外，ghrelin對胸腺細胞數量具有刺激作用，可增加早期胸腺前驅細胞與近期胸腺遷出細胞（recent thymic emigrants）。

context.en-US: The metabolic hormone ghrelin, a major regulator of food intake, also exerts immunomodulatory and thymopoietic effects. Ghrelin binds immune cell subsets via ghrelin-specific receptors and localizes to lipid rafts of activated T cells. Dixit et al. reported that ghrelin reduces age-associated inflammatory responses in mice, and in aged thymus both ghrelin and growth hormone levels decrease in correlation with functional thymic involution and elevated inflammation.
context.zh-TW: 代謝激素ghrelin（飢餓素）是食物攝取的主要調節者，也具有免疫調節與胸腺生成（thymopoietic）效應。Ghrelin透過ghrelin特異性受體與免疫細胞亞群結合，並定位於活化T細胞的脂筏。Dixit等人報告ghrelin可減少小鼠中年齡相關的發炎反應，而在老年胸腺中，ghrelin與生長激素水平均下降，與功能性胸腺退化及發炎升高相關。

context.en-US: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most malignant primary brain tumor in adults (grade IV astrocytoma).
context.zh-TW: 膠質母細胞瘤 (GBM) 是成人中最惡性的原發性腦腫瘤（IV級星形細胞瘤）。

context.en-US: Glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs) drive therapy resistance and recurrence.
context.zh-TW: 膠質母細胞瘤幹細胞樣細胞 (GSCs) 驅動治療抵抗和復發。

context.en-US: Standard therapy is maximal resection, radiotherapy and temozolomide; prognosis remains poor (median <15 months).
context.zh-TW: 標準治療是最大切除、放療和 temozolomide；預後仍然不良（中位數 <15 個月）。

context.en-US: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
context.zh-TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

context.en-US: Glutaredoxin is up-regulated in many tumors, supporting the redox fitness and drug resistance that mirror thioredoxin-system up-regulation. Grx inhibition is explored as a sensitizing strategy in oncology.
context.zh-TW: Glutaredoxin 在許多腫瘤中被上調，支持與硫氧還蛋白系統上調相呼應的氧化還原適應力與藥物抗性。Grx 抑制被探索作為腫瘤學中的增敏策略。

context.en-US: The classical glutaredoxin GLRX1 carries the CPYC variant of the CxxC redox-active tetrapeptide motif, through which it catalyzes both disulfide reduction and deglutathionylation. The motif's two cysteines mediate thiol-disulfide exchange using electrons from glutathione.
context.zh-TW: 經典的 glutaredoxin GLRX1 帶有 CxxC 氧化還原活性四肽基序的 CPYC 變體，藉此催化雙硫鍵還原與去麩胱甘肽化。此基序的兩個半胱氨酸利用麩胱甘肽的電子進行硫醇-雙硫交換。

context.en-US: Glutaredoxins use electrons from reduced glutathione (GSH) instead of thioredoxin reductase, passing them through a dithiol or monothiol mechanism to reduce protein disulfides and reverse protein S-glutathionylation. This makes glutaredoxin the GSH-coupled half of the cellular disulfide-reducing system.
context.zh-TW: Glutaredoxin 使用來自還原態麩胱甘肽（GSH）的電子而非硫氧還蛋白還原酶，透過雙硫醇或單硫醇機制還原蛋白質雙硫鍵並逆轉蛋白質的 S-麩胱甘肽化。這使 Glutaredoxin 成為細胞雙硫還原系統中與 GSH 偶聯的一半。

context.en-US: Glutaredoxins (Grx) reverse the reversible S-glutathionylation of mitochondrial manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD/SOD2), restoring its activity after oxidative inactivation. Under mitochondrial oxidative stress, MnSOD thiols can form glutathione-mixed disulfides (S-glutathionylation), which reduces its superoxide-dismutating activity; the Grx system (Grx1/Grx2, using GSH) deglutathionylates and reactivates the enzyme. This gives the GSH/glutaredoxin branch a direct reset hand on the compartmental SOD-peroxide relay, complementing the thioredoxin branch's regeneration of peroxiredoxins that consume MnSOD-derived hydrogen peroxide.
context.zh-TW: Glutaredoxins（Grx）可逆轉粒線體錳超氧化物歧化酶（MnSOD/SOD2）的可逆性 S-麩胱甘肽化，在氧化失活後恢復其活性。在粒線體氧化壓力下，MnSOD 的硫醇可形成麩胱甘肽混合雙硫鍵（S-麩胱甘肽化），從而降低其超氧化物歧化酶活性；Grx 系統（Grx1/Grx2，利用 GSH）去麩胱甘肽化並重新活化該酶。這使 GSH/glutaredoxin 分支對腔室化 SOD-過氧化物接力具有直接的復位作用，並與 thioredoxin 分支再生消耗 MnSOD 所產生過氧化氫的 peroxiredoxins 互補。

context.en-US: Glutaredoxin can regenerate peroxiredoxins in contexts where the thioredoxin route is limiting, providing a glutathione-routed alternative for peroxide detoxification. This supports redox defense when thioredoxin systems are impaired.
context.zh-TW: 在硫氧還蛋白途徑受限的情境下，Glutaredoxin 可以再生成過氧化還原酶，為過氧化物解毒提供一條經由麩胱甘肽的替代途徑。這在硫氧還蛋白系統受損時支持氧化還原防禦。

context.en-US: Glutaredoxin donates electrons to ribonucleotide reductase (RNR), providing a glutathione-routed backup to thioredoxin for de novo dNTP synthesis. Glutaredoxin was discovered through its ability to reduce RNR, and both systems can sustain ribonucleotide reduction.
context.zh-TW: Glutaredoxin 提供電子給核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR），為 de novo dNTP 合成提供一條經由麩胱甘肽路線、與硫氧還蛋白並行的備援途徑。Glutaredoxin 正是因其還原 RNR 的能力而被發現，兩者皆能維持核醣核苷酸還原作用。

subject: Glutathione

context.en-US: Glutathione, an antioxidant, keeps lipid peroxides at steady levels and thereby staves off ferroptosis in healthy cells. Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent cell death pathway in which the accumulation of lipid peroxides becomes toxic, and glutathione's antioxidant capacity is the canonical defense against this form of death. The Salk study's discovery is notable because the acid ceramidase axis sensitizes cells to ferroptosis without involving changes in glutathione levels, operating instead through lipid metabolism - an entirely novel, GPX4/GSH-independent pathway. This contrasts with the classical view that ferroptosis sensitivity is controlled chiefly by glutathione/GPX4-dependent peroxide neutralization.
context.zh-TW: 抗氧化劑麩胱甘肽將脂質過氧化物維持在穩定水平，從而保護健康細胞免受ferroptosis侵害。Ferroptosis是一種依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，其中脂質過氧化物的累積會產生毒性，而麩胱甘肽的抗氧化能力是對抗此種死亡形式的典型防禦。Salk研究的發現值得注意，因為酸性神經醯胺酶軸在不涉及麩胱甘肽水平變化的情況下使細胞對ferroptosis敏感化，而是透過脂質代謝運作——這是一條全新的、GPX4/GSH非依賴性途徑。這與「ferroptosis敏感性主要由麩胱甘肽/GPX4依賴性過氧化物中和所控制」的經典觀點形成對比。

subject: Glycation

context.en-US: Glycation is the product of the reaction between a sugar and the free amino group of proteins, referred to as cross-linking, and the accumulation of these glycation byproducts results in large, cross-linked molecules that inhibit the ability of the cell to function normally. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) accumulate with age in tissues, contributing to arterial stiffening and cardiac enlargement. Levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of non-diabetics, and AGEs are believed to play an important role in the development of diabetic complications.
context.zh-TW: 糖化（glycation）是糖與蛋白質游離胺基之間反應的產物，又稱交叉連結（cross-linking），而這些糖化副產物的累積會形成大型、交叉連結的分子，抑制細胞正常運作的能力。晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）隨年齡在組織中累積，促成動脈硬化與心臟肥大。糖尿病患者的交叉連結產物水平是非糖尿病患者的兩到三倍，且AGEs被認為在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。
